name: Switch M3TERS
role: Full-stack engineer: built end to end (API, dashboard, gateway agent)
summary: Switch Electric's platform for managing meters, gateways and telemetry: a Go agent on each LoRaWAN gateway, a Node.js API and a React dashboard with live readings, analytics, reports, signed agent updates and firmware updates over the air.
description: Switch M3TERS collects telemetry from Switch meters across LoRaWAN gateways. A Go agent on each gateway reads ChirpStack MQTT, keeps only registered meters on FPort 4, buffers to disk and forwards over HTTPS. The Node.js/Express API decodes the 97-byte Cumulus telemetry frame, stores raw events, measurements and hourly rollups in MongoDB, and streams updates to a React dashboard over Socket.IO. Ingestion is idempotent, and energy deltas survive meter restarts and late readings. End-to-end tests with the release binary covered two simulated meters, a 50-second API outage and an agent restart, with no lost or duplicated readings.
highlights: Go gateway agent: MQTT filtering, disk-buffered delivery, systemd service, and Ed25519-signed self-updates for amd64, arm64 and armv7 with automatic rollback
Dashboard: live per-phase readings, history charts, analytics (consumption, demand, power quality, RSSI/SNR, reliability), CSV/PDF reports, light and dark themes
Firmware updates over the air: upload signed meter firmware and run ChirpStack FUOTA campaigns per gateway; meters confirm the new version in their telemetry
Security: separate admin and agent APIs, hashed gateway credentials, bcrypt, rate limits, Zod validation, roles and invitations, audit logs
No lost or duplicated readings through an API outage and an agent restart in end-to-end tests
